Tomas Brandvold
418 Larch Street, Duluth, MN 55802

13 November 2026

Dear Returns Department,

I am writing about my Vantelle X14 laptop, serial VX14-0042718, bought on 3 August 2026 under order BW-558201. The left hinge cracked in the second week. I would like a replacement, not a refund.

Sincerely,
Tomas Brandvold

cases.text:
Dear Northwind Support,

My TR-220 router has dropped every evening for five weeks. I spoke to Ms. Okafor in Leeds on 9 September, ticket CB-77120, and again under CB-77392. The technician booked for 14 October never came, and I lost 40 percent of my service. I have waited three months in total.

Regards,
A customer

note: Characterization of the measures moved from examples/focus_calibration.rs (items.id=899 stage 1). Every input is invented. Expected values were produced by the pre-move code and are pinned unchanged, including its known quirks: a bracketed citation number such as [1] is flagged as an unsupported number, [2a] is read as a placeholder, and a spelled number or a capitalised word on a short all-capitals line is flagged.
